title: Value Unlocker
description: A simple minecraft mod that unlocks almost every float/value's range in chat commands, for fun and chaos.
body:
# Value Unlocker
> Unlock every number in all your commands.

## Warning!
> Incredibly large and small values are prone to either **crashing** your game or **bricking** your worlds, this is your warning, make backups if you care about the world you'll be experimenting with :P


This mod unlocks most restrictions applied by minecraft on chat commands, for example:
* tickrate
* gamerules
* NBT data
* the enchant command
* ~~the speed cap on experimental minecarts~~ (broken, we're working on it!)

Before, you could only _dream_ of running `/tick rate 10000000`, now you can! (not saying your computer will be alive to see it, of course).

Set the entity cram limit to 1, set player sleep percentage to 101 thereby disabling all sleeping, set tickrate to 0.0001 and brick your world, use speed 10000 to fly across the map! You can do anything!
